profile.headline: Senior Systems Software Engineer @ PlayStation
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Systems Software Engineer with a background spanning operating systems, kernel development, and low-level systems programming. My experience ranges from bare-metal firmware and multicore RTOS environments to embedded Linux applications and FreeBSD kernel drivers.

Currently at PlayStation, I develop and maintain FreeBSD kernel software implementing PSLink, Sony's proprietary wireless technology for PlayStation accessories. My work involves USB communication, kernel–userspace interfaces, concurrency, and wireless protocol development, with contributions to production PS5 system software releases.

Previously, I worked on multithreaded C++ audio distribution software at Sonos and power management software for Apple's 5G modem platform, including bare-metal firmware, RTOS development, and hardware bring-up.

I'm particularly interested in operating systems, kernel development, and the challenges of building reliable, high-performance systems software.

Outside of work, I explore Rust and its applications in systems programming through personal projects at https://nullbeach.com.

positions.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing and maintaining the FreeBSD kernel driver for PSLink, Sony's proprietary wireless technology for PlayStation accessories. 

- Primary in-house engineer responsible for extending the driver, integrating protocol changes, debugging system-level issues, and supporting production PS5 system software releases.

- Contributed to PS5 system software releases supporting FlexStrike wireless fight stick, PULSE Elevate wireless speakers, and the PlayStation PULSE wireless headset. 

- Work spans FreeBSD kernel development, USB communication, concurrency, firmware integration, and system-level debugging. Also drove improvements to automated testing and CI, including static analysis, platform builds, and unit and integration testing.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on the C++ audio distribution software powering Sonos products, with a focus on redesigning Channel Source, the first stage of the audio distribution pipeline.

- Implemented major portions of a redesign of the approximately 10 KLOC legacy subsystem, separating control and data paths to reduce coupling and improve testability and maintainability. Introduced test seams into tightly coupled code and applied the Adapter pattern to preserve existing interfaces during incremental migration.

- The work involved multithreaded C++ development, playback orchestration, queue management, audio framing, and downstream audio distribution.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed low-level power management software for Apple's next-generation 5G modem platform, working across bare-metal firmware and multicore RTOS environments.

- Owned implementation of Power Management IC (PMIC) firmware and developed real-time power management (RTPM) functionality for collecting and packaging telemetry used in dynamic frequency and voltage management.

- Investigated unexpected modem power consumption using Apple's proprietary tracing tools, developing Python data analysis tools and JavaScript visualizations to analyze PMIC and RTPM behavior. Work also involved hardware bring-up, firmware integration, and low-level debugging with LLDB.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer I
positions.description: Developing bare metal firmware on microcontrollers for novel home security products on the Sensors engineering team.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed 3 VxLAN feature tests in Python to check functionality in edge-case scenarios and detect regressions. Capitalized on Pytest fixtures to permute through potential network switch configurations. Consolidated network switch command line debugging tools by reducing required input complexity by a factor of 10. Participated in daily stand-up meetings, code reviews, and team demos​.​ Collaborated closely with Infrastructure and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality product code.

company.name: Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise company

positions.title: Hardware Design Intern
positions.description: Assisted in prototype board 'bring-up' and design verification testing by writing Python scripts to exercise key communications interfaces and device functionality.  Consulted data sheets to write low-level device drivers for new parts on the prototype. Used Linux environment to deploy test scripts and execute OS-level commands. Used hardware analysis tools ('scope, logic analyzer) to verify signal behavior.
